sources.title: Colovore: Colovore completes first liquid-cooled AI data center in Reno metro area to support companies deploying high-density computing (September 9, 2026)
sources.summary: Colovore's release dated 9 September 2026 says the company has officially opened the first liquid-cooled AI data center on its RNO01 campus in Sparks, Nevada, in the Reno metro area, celebrated with a ribbon cutting. It says this first data center is fully leased by customers and provides 6 MW of liquid-cooled infrastructure, uses no municipal water for cooling and targets a PUE of 1.3. A second data center is under construction on the RNO01 campus with projected completion in February 2027.
sources.date_semantics: Release date printed on the page (September 9, 2026, Santa Clara). The present-perfect statement that the first data center has officially opened is used as the operating observation on the release day; the ribbon-cutting day is not stated separately. The February 2027 completion of the second building is a forecast.

sources.title: Nevada Governor’s Office of Economic Development: 5 C. Colovore Reno 1 LLC Board Packet (data center sales and use tax and personal property tax abatements)
sources.publisher: Nevada Governor’s Office of Economic Development (GOED)
sources.attribution: State of Nevada, Governor’s Office of Economic Development
sources.summary: GOED's board packet for Colovore Reno 1 LLC (summary page dated 5 August 2026; item 5 C) presents an application for the data-center sales and use tax and personal property tax abatements for a computer data center in Storey County (NAICS 518210, new application). The application form gives the proposed/actual Nevada facility address as 100 Italy Drive, McCarran, Storey County 89437, an expected new operation date of Q4 2026, USD 30 million of capital equipment, ten jobs, about USD 80 million of construction cost and a 75,000 sq ft building under a lease, and says the project is the company's first Nevada data-centre presence. The company timeline in the packet lists the groundbreaking of its first Reno facility (RNO01) and says the first Reno site (16 MW in RNO01) is fully committed ahead of delivery. The packet does not itself record a board decision.
sources.date_semantics: The summary page is dated August 5, 2026 (the board meeting); the file sits in the July 2026 upload folder, so its publication day is not established and is left null. Used for the facility address and identity only, not as a status observation.

sources.title: Storey County Board of County Commissioners: Notice of a Possible Quorum, Colovore Data Center Ribbon Cutting, Wednesday September 9, 2026, 100 Italy Dr., McCarran, NV 89437
sources.attribution: Storey County Board of County Commissioners, Nevada
sources.summary: Storey County's notice of a possible quorum of its Board of Commissioners at the Colovore Data Center ribbon cutting, Wednesday 9 September 2026 at 11:00 a.m., at Colovore Data Center, 100 Italy Dr., McCarran, NV 89437. The clerk's certification states the notice was posted on or before 4 September 2026 at the courthouse and three fire stations.
sources.date_semantics: Posted on or before 4 September 2026 (certification of posting; scanned PDF created 4 September 2026), so no exact publication day is set. It schedules the 9 September event and is used for identity and address only: it ties the ribbon cutting described in Colovore's release to 100 Italy Dr, McCarran. Not a status observation.

sources.title: Colovore: Reno market page (RNO01 Sparks and RNO02 Reno)
sources.summary: Colovore's Reno market page lists two Reno-area sites: RNO01, location Sparks, NV, 16 MW total in Hall 1 (8 MW) and Hall 2 (8 MW), marked sold out; and RNO02, location Reno, NV, 16 MW, pre-leasing for 2026-2027. No street address or map coordinate is given.
sources.date_semantics: Undated live operator page captured 22 October 2026; used for site identity only. Its per-hall 8 MW figures differ from the 6 MW stated in the 9 September release for the first data center, so no capacity is recorded.

sources.title: City of Phoenix Planning and Development, Planning_Permit MapServer layer 1 (Current Permits, 2 years): permits at 2500 W Union Hills Dr (Aligned Phoenix campus)
sources.publisher: City of Phoenix, Arizona (Planning and Development Department)
sources.attribution: City of Phoenix Planning and Development Department
sources.summary: The city's current-permits layer returns 137 permit rows at 2500 W Union Hills Dr. Building permits 23003918 'ALIGNED ENERGY PHX-05 CORE AND SHELL' (commercial shell; issued 23 February 2023) and 23020602 'PHX05-1 CORE AND SHELL BLD 5 FLR 1,2,ROO[F]' (issued 19 October 2023), together with 23008884 'PHX05-2 - COMMON AREAS - 1 & 2 FLOOR' and 23009281 'PHX05-4, 2ND FLOOR TI', all have status DONE with permit complete date 26 August 2026; the campus grading (23003892) and stormwater (22028625) permits were completed the same day and the site civil permit (23004622) on 24 August 2026. Temporary certificates of occupancy for the PHX-05 first-floor data area and second-floor TI (26004974, 26004979; issued 2 April 2026) are DONE as of 21 August 2026. Permit 23009280 'PHX 05-3 1ST FLOOR DATA' remains OPEN (expires 1 December 2026), as do PHX-05 data-hall battery permits and a generator-exhaust permit. Other rows cover the PHX-01/02/03 buildings on the same campus.
sources.date_semantics: The status observation is the permit complete date (PER_COMPL_DATE, midnight Arizona time) of 26 August 2026 for the PHX-05 core-and-shell permits, whose status is DONE; the layer's other status codes are OPEN, EXPR (expired) and VOID, so DONE is neither an expiry nor a voiding, and these permits were completed before their 1 October 2026 expiry. published_at is a lower bound for the captured layer version: the most recent permit issue timestamp in the layer at retrieval falls on 21 October 2026 (see the layer-currency capture), not a permit date. Completion of the core-and-shell, common-area and second-floor TI permits establishes completion of those building works only; the first-floor data-hall permit is still open, and no operation, IT load or tenancy is inferred.
sources.personal_data_note: Query omits the company-contact (PROFESS_NAME) and permit-lead fields; no personal data is restated.

sources.title: Aligned Data Centers: Phoenix data centers (PHX-01/02/03, PHX-04, PHX-05, PHX-06, PHX-07)
sources.summary: Aligned's Phoenix page lists PHX-01/02/03 and PHX-05 data centers at 2500 W Union Hills Drive, Phoenix, AZ 85027, each described as a 55-acre campus designed to Tier III standards, PHX-04 at 2501 S Price Rd and PHX-06 at 2955 West Innovation Street in Chandler, and PHX-07 at 8785 N Reems Rd, Waddell.
